title: services.services.restore
description: Puts an archived service of THIS hub back into the catalogue (`hub_id` injected by the runtime, never sent): it undoes `services.services.delete` — the soft-delete goes, `is_active` returns to 1, and nothing else is touched (services#44). It exists as its own door because `services.services.update` demands `is_deleted = 0` and therefore cannot reach an archived row. A service that is not archived — or is not of this hub — affects 0 rows and the command is REFUSED (`expect_rows`), not silently accepted. Closed contract (services#9).

service_id.description: Id of the archived service to bring back.
